title: zehneria macrantha
intro: Zehneria macrantha, commonly known as the wild snake gourd or Makandi, is a type of flowering plant in the family Cucurbitaceae. It is native to tropical regions of Asia and is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Zehneria macrantha are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which can provide relief from pain and swelling. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal effects.
